tasks.title: Frontend Apple sign-in button gated by diagnostic last-7d PASS
tasks.prompt:
You are an OpenCode V4 Pro subagent. Repo: /Users/danielpenin/whatsapp_saas. Read CLAUDE.md. Never git restore.

MISSION: Parte 8.1 frontend complement — the 'Continuar com Apple' button only renders when /auth/apple/diagnostic returns configured===true && lastProbe.result==='PASS' && probeAt within 7d.

DEPENDS: wave-1 task wave1-apple-validation must have created /auth/apple/diagnostic endpoint. Read backend/src/auth/apple-login-diagnostic.controller.ts; if missing, document gap and exit with code 4.

FILES YOU OWN:
- frontend/src/components/login/AppleSignInButton.tsx (find existing OR create new wrapper)
- frontend/src/hooks/useAppleDiagnostic.ts (new — SWR hook to /auth/apple/diagnostic)
- frontend/src/hooks/useAppleDiagnostic.test.tsx (new)
- frontend/src/lib/api/apple.ts (new — typed client)

SPEC:
useAppleDiagnostic() returns { ready: boolean, configured: boolean, lastProbeAt: Date | null, lastProbeResult: 'PASS'|'FAIL'|null }. `ready` is true only when configured + PASS + within 7d.

AppleSignInButton renders 'Continuar com Apple' when ready===true. Otherwise hides and emits a console.warn (no toast).

  cd frontend && npm run lint -- src/hooks/useAppleDiagnostic.ts src/lib/api/apple.ts 2>&1 | tail -10

- feat(frontend/auth): Apple sign-in button gated by diagnostic (P8.1)

FINAL REPORT: hook signature, gating logic, sample diagnostic response.

tasks.title: Inbound golden-path integration test (Parte 12 verification)
